body_markdown:
*“Don’t you love New York in the fall? It makes me wanna buy school supplies.”*


This quote from You’ve Got Mail could not sum up the vibes in New York right now. Sweaters are out and about, and the people are exploring the city. What better way to explore than to see what annual festivals are worth checking out.


## [Manhattan](https://www.renthop.com/search?areas=manhattan-new-york-ny)


### Hallowscream Fright Walk


Basketball Courts (in J. Hood Wright Park)


October 16, 2026 – Free – 4pm – 7pm


A spooky celebration at J. Hood Wright Park. Wear your best costume and get ready for the scariest party in town in our interactive haunted house!


### Fall Festival


Dyckman Farmhouse Museum (in Dyckman House Museum)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 10am – 3pm


A day packed with fun, creativity, and a touch of history.


Fall Fest – West 104th Street Garden – October 17, 2026 – Free – 11am – 3pm – Annual harvest party that brings together the entire neighborhood with a number of educational and family-friendly activities, from a seed swap to big games.


### Hallowscream Fright Walk & Fall Festival


Basketball Courts (in J. Hood Wright Park)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 3pm


### Fall Celebration at Family Community Garden


Family Community Garden


October 17, 2026 – Free – 3pm – 5pm


Fall Celebration with a children’s story time, arts & crafts, and the garden group will also be giving out FREE books and bookbags! While supplies last.


### Gatehouse Garden’s Fall Festival


Gatehouse Garden


October 18, 2026 – Free – 1pm – 5pm


A celebration of another good season! Festivities will include Pumpkin Piñata Smash (sweets for kids of any age), Autumn Arts & Crafts, games, and more!


## [Bronx](https://www.renthop.com/search?bathrooms=0&q=&areas=bronx-new-york-ny&min_price=0&max_price=100000&sort=hopscore)


### Boo Bash in the Bronx


St. James Park


October 10, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Join NYC Parks and Council Member Pierina Sanchez at St. James Park for the ultimate fall celebration! Don your best costume for a jam-packed day of seasonal fun. Activities will include carnival games, creative crafts, face painting, and more. This event is free and open to the public.


### Williamsbridge Fall Fiesta


Williamsbridge Oval Recreation Center (in Williamsbridge Oval Recreation Center)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 11am – 2pm


Join NYC Parks at Williamsbridge Oval Park for A Fall Fiesta: Where Memories Take Flight! Dive into a colorful day of pumpkin decorating, creative autumn crafts, interactive science adventures, a cheerful pumpkin patch, and a spirited dog costume parade.


### The Great Pumpkin Spooktacular


Lafayette Avenue and Morrison Avenue (in Soundview Park)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Join NYC Parks and Council Member Amanda Farias at Soundview Park for the ultimate fall celebration! Bring the whole family down for a jam-packed day of seasonal fun, activities will include festive games, pumpkin picking & decorating, and more. This event is free and open to the public.


### Spooktacular Fiesta


Loreto Playground


October 24, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Join NYC Parks and Council Member Shirley Aldebol at Loreto Playground for a spooktacular fiesta! Bring the family, friends, and neighbors to enjoy a day of games, seasonal crafts, family fun, and more. This event is free and open to the public.


### Pumpkin Palooza


Basketball Courts (in St. Mary’s Park)


October 31, 2026 – Free – 1pm – 4pm


Join NYC Parks and Council Member Elsie Encarnacion at St. Mary’s Playground West for the ultimate fall celebration! Bring the whole family down for a jam-packed day of fall colors, games, and unforgettable family fun. This event is free and open to the public.


## [Brooklyn](https://www.renthop.com/search?bathrooms=0&q=&areas=brooklyn-new-york-ny&min_price=0&max_price=100000&sort=hopscore)


### Fall Festival with Councilmember Vernikov


Asser Levy Park Play Area (in Asser Levy Park)


October 11, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 3pm


Join NYC Parks for a Fall Festival Celebration with Councilmember Inna Vernikov! Activities include sports, games, arts and crafts, inflatables, and a pumpkin patch for all to enjoy!


### Paint, Party & Connect: Artists & the Garden Harvest


Concerned Residents of Barbey Street Community Garden


October 11, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 3pm


The garden group is inviting artists to paint alongside what they’re growing and to bring their creativity by painting together, adding color to our garden and connecting with neighbors.


### Hart to Hart Fall Festival


Hart to Hart Community Garden


October 17, 2026 – Free – 11am – 4pm


Join the garden group for activities in the garden including Pumpkin and plant pot painting, face painting, Día de los Muertos crafts, herb harvesting and drying and more.


### Fall Festival with Councilmember Santosuosso


Kaiser Park Lawn 2 (in Kaiser Park)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Join NYC Parks for a Fall Festival Celebration with Councilmember Kayla Santosuosso! Activities include sports, games, arts and crafts, inflatables, and a pumpkin patch for all to enjoy!


### Prospect Farm Fall Harvest Festival


Prospect Farm


October 18, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Prospect Farm will host its annual Fall Harvest Festival with music, bake sale, arts and crafts for all ages, and compost giveaway.


### Fall Children’s Harvest Celebration


Union St. Garden and Community Development


October 24, 2026 – Free – 1pm – 5pm


Please join us for our annual Fall Children’s Harvest Festival as we close out the garden with fun (and spooky!) activities.


## [Queens](https://www.renthop.com/search?bathrooms=0&q=&areas=queens-new-york-ny&min_price=0&max_price=100000&sort=hopscore)


### Rockaway Fall Festival


Beach 17 O’Donohue Park (in Rockaway Beach and Boardwalk)


October 12, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Bring your family and friends for a fun filled day at the Rockaway Fall Festival. There will be a pumpkin maze, pumpkin patch, Mechanical rides, light refreshments, giveaways, arts & crafts, games, and music.


### Fall Festival at Victory Field


Victory Field (in Forest Park)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 3pm


Welcome to the fall with fun activities, including games and entertainment, pumpkins and more. This event is sponsored by Councilmember Joann Ariola and The Forest Park Trust.


### Springfield Park Fall Festival


Lawn Area (in Springfield Park)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Join us for a day of Fall Family Fun at Springfield Park featuring activities including pumpkin decorating, arts & crafts, music, inflatables, animal education, face painting, sensory activities, games & more!


### Juniper Valley Park Fall Festival


Multipurpose Play Area (Hard Top) (in Juniper Valley Park)


October 24, 2026 – Free – 11:30am – 2:30pm


Join NYC Parks and Council Member Phil Wong for a day of fun Halloween activities including inflatables, crafts, games, music, pumpkin picking and more.


### Wayanda Park Fall Festival


Grass Field (in Wayanda Park)


October 24, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 4pm


Join us for a day of Fall Family Fun at Wayanda Park featuring activities including pumpkin decorating, arts & crafts, music, inflatables, a trackless train ride, animal education, games & more!


### Mad Monster Lab Haunted House & Fall Festival


Bowne Park Field House (in Bowne Park)


October 30, 2026 – Free –


4pm – 8pm


Join NYC Parks for an afternoon of family friendly fun and frights, with a pumpkin patch, create fun arts & crafts projects, bounce on inflatables, and dance & party to Halloween themed music.


## [Staten Island](https://www.renthop.com/search?bathrooms=0&q=&areas=staten-island-new-york-ny&min_price=0&max_price=100000&sort=hopscore)


### Faber Park Fright Fest


Outdoors at Faber Park Recreation Center (in Faber Park Recreation Center)


October 17, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 3pm


Get ready for a frightfully fun time at Faber Park Fright Fest! Join NYC Parks and Staten Island Recreation for a family-friendly Halloween celebration filled with festive fun. Pick and paint your own pumpkin, create spooky arts and crafts, enjoy jumbo games, and take part in other Halloween activities. Looking for a little competition? Hit the court and show off your skills in our 3-on-3 basketball tournament!


### De Matti’s Tot Pumpkin Patch


DeMatti Park Fieldhouse (in De Matti Park)


October 21, 2026 – Free – 10am – 5pm


Join NYC Parks and Staten Island Recreation at De Matti Playground for a spooktacular Halloween celebration for the whole family!


### Greenbelt’s Haunted Trail


Lower Parking Lot (in Greenbelt Recreation Center)


October 23, 2026 – Free – 3pm – 7pm


Join NYC Parks and Staten Island Recreation for Greenbelt’s Haunted Trail, a fun-filled Halloween celebration for the whole family!


### Conference House Haunted Trail


H.H. Biddle House (in Conference House Park)


October 24, 2026 – Free – 12pm – 3pm


Join NYC Parks and Staten Island Recreation at the historic Conference House for a spooktacular afternoon of Halloween fun!


### McDonald’s Pumpkin Patch


Front Entrance (in Austin J. McDonald Playground)


October 29, 2026 – Free – 3pm – 5pm


Join NYC Parks and Staten Island Recreation at McDonald’s Playground for a spooktacular Halloween celebration for the whole family!


### Wicked Walker Family Fun & Halloween Event


Walker Park Field House (in Walker Park)


October 30, 2026 – Free – 3:30pm – 6pm


Join NYC Parks and Staten Island Recreation for Wicked Walker, a spooktacular, family-friendly Halloween celebration at Walker Park!
